name: whatsapp-api
description: WhatsApp Business Cloud API: send messages and templates, manage media, templates and the business profile

nodes.title: Send WhatsApp text
nodes.description: Send a text message. Only allowed within 24 h of the recipient's last message; otherwise use send_template. (as an agent tool only when WHATSAPP_TOOL_ALLOW_SEND=1 and the recipient is in WHATSAPP_TOOL_RECIPIENT_ALLOWLIST)

to.description: Recipient in international E.164 format, e.g. "6281234567890" or "+62 812-3456-7890"

preview_url.description: Render a link preview for the first URL

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Send WhatsApp template
nodes.description: Send an approved message template. Required for the first message and outside the 24 h window. (as an agent tool only when WHATSAPP_TOOL_ALLOW_SEND=1 and the recipient is in WHATSAPP_TOOL_RECIPIENT_ALLOWLIST)

to.description: Recipient in international E.164 format, e.g. "6281234567890" or "+62 812-3456-7890"

language.description: Template language code, e.g. en_US, id

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Send WhatsApp media
nodes.description: Send an image, video, audio, document or sticker by public https link or uploaded media_id. 24 h window rules apply. (as an agent tool only when WHATSAPP_TOOL_ALLOW_SEND=1 and the recipient is in WHATSAPP_TOOL_RECIPIENT_ALLOWLIST)

to.description: Recipient in international E.164 format, e.g. "6281234567890" or "+62 812-3456-7890"

media_type.description: Kind of media (sent as the message `type`)

link.description: Public https URL of the file (instead of media_id)

filename.description: File name shown to the recipient (document only)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Send WhatsApp location

to.description: Recipient in international E.164 format, e.g. "6281234567890" or "+62 812-3456-7890"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data

nodes.title: Send WhatsApp reply buttons
nodes.description: Send a message with up to 3 quick-reply buttons (title up to 20 characters). 24 h window rules apply. (as an agent tool only when WHATSAPP_TOOL_ALLOW_SEND=1 and the recipient is in WHATSAPP_TOOL_RECIPIENT_ALLOWLIST)

to.description: Recipient in international E.164 format, e.g. "6281234567890" or "+62 812-3456-7890"

buttons.description: Button titles, or objects {"id","title"}; the id comes back in the reply webhook

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Send WhatsApp list
nodes.description: Send a list message: a button that opens up to 10 rows grouped in sections. 24 h window rules apply. (as an agent tool only when WHATSAPP_TOOL_ALLOW_SEND=1 and the recipient is in WHATSAPP_TOOL_RECIPIENT_ALLOWLIST)

to.description: Recipient in international E.164 format, e.g. "6281234567890" or "+62 812-3456-7890"

button_text.description: Label of the button that opens the list (up to 20 characters)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

nodes.title: Upload WhatsApp media
nodes.description: Download a file from a public https URL and upload it to WhatsApp; returns data.id for send_media. Limits: image 5 MB, video/audio 16 MB, document 100 MB, sticker 500 KB.

url.description: Public https URL of the file

media_type.description: How the file will be sent (image, video, audio, document or sticker)

mime_type.description: MIME type to use when the server reports no Content-Type or application/octet-stream (ignored otherwise)

filename.description: File name for the upload (default: upload.<extension from the MIME type>)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get WhatsApp media URL
nodes.description: Get the download URL, MIME type, size and sha256 of a media id. The URL expires after 5 minutes and needs the access token to download.

phone_number_id.description: Optional: only succeed if the media belongs to this phone number id

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)
